ex.py: Tā xiǎng qù Yīngguó liú xué.
ex.en: He wants to study in Britain.

ex.py: Tā de Yīngyǔ shuǐpíng hěn gāo.
ex.en: Her English level is high.

ex.hz: 多听多说，你的汉语会提高得很快。
ex.py: Duō tīng duō shuō, nǐ de Hànyǔ huì tígāo de hěn kuài.
ex.en: Listen and speak more and your Chinese will improve fast.

ex.py: Zhèxiē liànxí bú tài nán.
ex.en: These exercises are not too hard.

ex.hz: 我今天的工作还没完成。
ex.py: Wǒ jīntiān de gōngzuò hái méi wánchéng.
ex.en: I haven't finished today's work yet.

ex.py: Qǐng nǐ zài xiě yí ge jùzi.
ex.en: Please write one more sentence.

ex.hz: 我只认识小王，其他人我都不认识。
ex.py: Wǒ zhǐ rènshi Xiǎo Wáng, qítā rén wǒ dōu bú rènshi.
ex.en: I only know Xiao Wang; I don't know anyone else.

ex.py: Wǒ gěi nǐ fā yí ge duǎnxìn ba.
ex.en: I'll send you a text message.

ex.hz: 老师对我们的要求很高。
ex.py: Lǎoshī duì wǒmen de yāoqiú hěn gāo.
ex.en: The teacher's demands on us are high.

ex.py: Guò mǎlù yào zhùyì ānquán.
ex.en: Pay attention to safety when crossing the road.

ex.py: Xiǎoyún shì wǒ de hǎo péngyou.
ex.en: Xiaoyun is my good friend.

ex.hz: 我晚上常常上网看电影。
ex.py: Wǒ wǎnshang chángcháng shàng wǎng kàn diànyǐng.
ex.en: In the evening I often go online to watch films.

ex.hz: 除了苹果，我还想买一些香蕉。
ex.py: Chúle píngguǒ, wǒ hái xiǎng mǎi yìxiē xiāngjiāo.
ex.en: Besides apples, I also want to buy some bananas.

ex.py: Bàba měi tiān wǎnshang kàn xīnwén.
ex.en: Dad watches the news every evening.

ex.hz: 这件衣服花了我三百块。
ex.py: Zhè jiàn yīfu huā le wǒ sānbǎi kuài.
ex.en: This piece of clothing cost me 300 yuan.

ex.py: Zhège diànyǐng hǎokàn jí le.
ex.en: This film is extremely good.

ex.hz: 春节是中国最重要的节日。
ex.py: Chūnjié shì Zhōngguó zuì zhòngyào de jiérì.
ex.en: Spring Festival is China's most important holiday.

ex.py: Xuéxiào míngtiān jǔxíng bǐsài.
ex.en: The school is holding a competition tomorrow.

ex.hz: 他去过世界上很多地方。
ex.py: Tā qù guo shìjiè shang hěn duō dìfang.
ex.en: He has been to many places in the world.

ex.py: Zhè tiáo jiēdào hěn gānjìng.
ex.en: This street is very clean.

ex.hz: 各个国家都有自己的节日。
ex.py: Gègè guójiā dōu yǒu zìjǐ de jiérì.
ex.en: Every country has its own holidays.

ex.py: Wǒ xǐhuan liǎojiě Zhōngguó wénhuà.
ex.en: I like learning about Chinese culture.

lines.hz: 我在上网看新闻，还想找几个句子练习写汉字。
lines.py: Wǒ zài shàng wǎng kàn xīnwén, hái xiǎng zhǎo jǐ ge jùzi liànxí xiě Hànzì.
lines.en: I'm reading the news online, and I want to find some sentences to practise writing characters.

lines.hz: 你的汉语水平比以前高多了！
lines.py: Nǐ de Hànyǔ shuǐpíng bǐ yǐqián gāo duō le!
lines.en: Your Chinese is much better than before!

lines.hz: 谢谢。除了每天练习，我还常常看中国电影。
lines.py: Xièxie. Chúle měi tiān liànxí, wǒ hái chángcháng kàn Zhōngguó diànyǐng.
lines.en: Thanks. Besides practising every day, I often watch Chinese films.

questions.q: What else does B do to improve?

lines.hz: 下个星期学校要举行唱歌比赛，你来不来？
lines.py: Xià ge xīngqī xuéxiào yào jǔxíng chàng gē bǐsài, nǐ lái bu lái?
lines.en: The school is holding a singing contest next week. Are you coming?

lines.py: Dāngrán lái. Xiǎoyún yě qù ma?
lines.en: Of course. Is Xiaoyun going too?

lines.hz: 除了她，其他同学都说要去。
lines.py: Chúle tā, qítā tóngxué dōu shuō yào qù.
lines.en: Apart from her, all the other classmates say they will go.

lines.py: Nà wǒ gěi tā fā ge duǎnxìn ba.
lines.en: Then I'll send her a message.

questions.q: What will the school hold next week?

grammar.en: 除了 A 以外，都 …: everyone/everything except A does it

drills.q: ___这本书以外，别的书我都看过。
drills.en: I've read every book except this one.

drills.q: 除了小李以外，其他同学___来了。
drills.en: Everyone except Xiao Li has come.

drills.q: 我们学校除了王老师，其他老师___是男的。
drills.en: In our school, all the teachers except Teacher Wang are men.

drills.q: 除了周末，我___天都要上班。
drills.en: Except at weekends, I work every day.
Apart from him, all of us have been to the Great Wall.

grammar.en: 除了 A 以外，还 B: A and also B

drills.q: 除了咖啡以外，他___喜欢喝茶。
drills.en: Besides coffee, he also likes tea.
Besides English, I can speak Chinese too.
Besides singing, she can dance too.
Besides basketball, he likes swimming too.

drills.q: 除了这件衣服以外，我___买了一条裤子。
drills.en: Besides this piece of clothing, I also bought a pair of trousers.

grammar.en: 有没有什么 …: “什么” makes a question softer, and the sentence means the same without it

drills.en: Would you like something to eat?
Are there any problems with your homework?
Is there anything you want to buy?
Do you have any plans for this weekend?
There aren't many people here; let's sit down.

grammar.en: Adj / mental verb + 极了: extremely

drills.en: This park is extremely beautiful.

drills.q: 今天的天气好___，我们去爬山吧。
drills.en: The weather is wonderful today; let's go hiking.
The food my mother makes is extremely tasty.

drills.q: 听到这个好消息，他高兴___。
drills.en: He was extremely happy to hear the good news.
I like that film extremely.
